# PetPawCalc

> Free calculators and guides for dog and cat owners in the US. PetPawCalc provides instant, research-backed answers about pet age, nutrition, weight, pregnancy, costs, and insurance — built for pet parents, not veterinarians.

PetPawCalc is a free tool-first resource. Every calculator is designed to give practical, actionable output — not just information. All content is written for US pet owners and calibrated to current veterinary guidelines. No signup required for any tool.

## Tools

- [Dog Age Calculator](https://petpawcalc.com/tools/dog-age-calculator.html): Converts dog years to human years using size-adjusted aging curves. Accounts for the fact that large breeds age faster than small breeds, and that dogs age rapidly in their first two years.

- [Cat Age Calculator](https://petpawcalc.com/tools/cat-age-calculator.html): Converts cat years to human years based on feline aging research. Distinguishes between the rapid development phase (years 1–2) and the more gradual aging of adult cats.

- [Pet Food Calorie Calculator](https://petpawcalc.com/tools/pet-food-calorie-calculator.html): Calculates daily calorie needs for dogs and cats based on weight, age, neuter status, and activity level using the Resting Energy Requirement (RER) formula.

- [Dog Weight Calculator](https://petpawcalc.com/tools/dog-weight-calculator.html): Estimates a puppy's adult weight based on current age and weight, with size-specific maturity timelines. Also helps assess whether an adult dog is at a healthy weight.

- [Annual Pet Cost Calculator](https://petpawcalc.com/tools/annual-pet-cost-calculator.html): Estimates total annual cost of owning a dog or cat, broken down by category: food, vet care, grooming, insurance, supplies, and boarding.

- [Pet Insurance Cost Estimator](https://petpawcalc.com/tools/pet-insurance-cost-estimator.html): Estimates monthly pet insurance premiums based on species, breed size, age, and US location. Covers accident-and-illness plans.

- [Dog Pregnancy Calculator](https://petpawcalc.com/tools/dog-pregnancy-calculator.html): Calculates estimated due date and delivery window from mating date. Includes a week-by-week pregnancy development guide covering all 9 weeks of gestation.

- [Dog Heat Cycle Calculator](https://petpawcalc.com/tools/dog-heat-cycle-calculator.html): Predicts next heat date and fertile window based on last heat date and breed size. Breaks down all four stages of the canine estrous cycle (proestrus, estrus, diestrus, anestrus) with estimated dates.

- [Dog Vet Visit Scheduler](https://petpawcalc.com/tools/dog-vet-visit-scheduler.html): Enter your dog's age, size, and last vet visit date to get a personalized next checkup date, urgency status, and a life-stage-specific visit agenda covering what to discuss with your vet.

- [Cat Vet Visit Scheduler](https://petpawcalc.com/tools/cat-vet-visit-scheduler.html): Enter your cat's age, lifestyle (indoor/outdoor), and last vet visit date to get a personalized next checkup date, urgency status, and a life-stage-specific visit agenda covering what to discuss with your vet.

- [Cat Pregnancy Calculator](https://petpawcalc.com/tools/cat-pregnancy-calculator.html): Calculates estimated due date and delivery window from mating date. Includes a week-by-week pregnancy development guide covering all 9 weeks of feline gestation, with care tips for each stage.

- [Cat Weight Calculator](https://petpawcalc.com/tools/cat-weight-calculator.html): Checks whether an adult cat is at a healthy weight based on breed type and sex, using breed-specific ranges. Also estimates a kitten's adult weight from current age and weight.

- [Dog Quality of Life Calculator](https://petpawcalc.com/tools/dog-quality-of-life-calculator.html): Assesses a dog's quality of life across 7 categories using the veterinary HHHHHMM Scale (Hurt, Hunger, Hydration, Hygiene, Happiness, Mobility, More good days than bad). Produces a scored summary with flags for urgent concerns. Designed for senior dogs and dogs with illness or chronic pain.

- [Cat Quality of Life Calculator](https://petpawcalc.com/tools/cat-quality-of-life-calculator.html): Assesses a cat's quality of life across the same 7-category veterinary HHHHHMM Scale, adapted with cat-specific behavioral cues (grooming habits, litter box access, hiding behavior) since cats mask illness and pain far more than dogs. Produces a scored summary with flags for urgent concerns. Designed for senior cats and cats with illness or chronic pain.

- [Cat Heat Cycle Calculator](https://petpawcalc.com/tools/cat-heat-cycle-calculator.html): Predicts a cat's next heat date, fertile window, and each stage of the feline estrous cycle based on her last heat date and lifestyle (indoor/outdoor). Explains the difference between proestrus, estrus, and interestrus, and notes that cats are induced ovulators — ovulation only occurs if mating takes place.

- [Pet Weight Calculator](https://petpawcalc.com/tools/pet-weight-calculator.html): Combined dog and cat weight checker. Lets users select species, then checks current weight against breed-typical ranges, plus an interactive 3-point Body Condition Score (BCS) self-check (ribs, waist, belly tuck). Links to the dedicated Dog Weight Calculator and Cat Weight Calculator for more detail.

- [Dog Vaccination Schedule Calculator](https://petpawcalc.com/tools/dog-vaccination-schedule-calculator.html): Enter a dog's age and lifestyle (boarding/daycare, dog parks, outdoor/rural exposure) to get a personalized vaccine status list — core vaccines (DHPP, rabies) and lifestyle-driven non-core vaccines (Bordetella, leptospirosis, canine influenza) — flagged as due, upcoming, recommended, or up to date, with typical cost ranges per vaccine.

- [Cat Vaccination Schedule Calculator](https://petpawcalc.com/tools/cat-vaccination-schedule-calculator.html): Enter a cat's age and lifestyle (indoor-only, indoor with other cats, outdoor access) to get a personalized vaccine status list — core vaccines (FVRCP, rabies) and lifestyle-driven FeLV recommendation — flagged as due, upcoming, recommended, or up to date, with typical cost ranges per vaccine.

- [Spay/Neuter Cost Calculator](https://petpawcalc.com/tools/spay-neuter-cost-calculator.html): Select dog or cat, spay or neuter, clinic type (private vs. low-cost), and optional add-ons (bloodwork, microchip, e-collar) to get an instant total cost estimate. Accounts for dog size/weight as a cost multiplier.

- [Dental Cleaning Cost Calculator](https://petpawcalc.com/tools/dental-cleaning-cost-calculator.html): Select dog or cat and estimated dental severity (mild/moderate/severe, with expected number of extractions) plus optional pre-anesthetic bloodwork, to get a total cost estimate covering base cleaning, bloodwork, and per-tooth extraction costs.

- [Pet Grooming Cost Calculator](https://petpawcalc.com/tools/pet-grooming-cost-calculator.html): Select dog or cat, size (for dogs), coat type (short/medium/long/curly), and professional grooming frequency to get an annual grooming cost estimate covering both professional visits and home maintenance supplies.

- [Flea & Tick Prevention Cost Calculator](https://petpawcalc.com/tools/flea-tick-prevention-cost-calculator.html): Select dog or cat, dog weight tier, and product type (basic topical, oral chewable, combo with heartworm, or 8-month collar) to get an instant annual and monthly cost estimate, plus a comparison of prevention cost vs. the cost of treating a flea infestation, heartworm, or tick-borne disease.

## Blog

- [How to Calculate Your Dog's Age in Human Years (It's Not 7x)](https://petpawcalc.com/blog/dog-age-human-years): Explains why the multiply-by-7 rule is inaccurate, how dogs actually age by life stage, and why size is the most important variable.

- [How Much Does a Dog Really Cost Per Year?](https://petpawcalc.com/blog/annual-cost-of-owning-a-dog): Full annual cost breakdown by category (food, vet, grooming, insurance, boarding) with ranges by dog size. Includes costs that commonly surprise new owners.

- [How Much Should I Feed My Dog?](https://petpawcalc.com/blog/how-much-to-feed-a-dog): Explains how to calculate the right daily food amount using RER, with adjustments for life stage, activity level, and neuter status. Covers common feeding mistakes.

- [How Much Should a Senior Dog Eat?](https://petpawcalc.com/blog/how-much-should-senior-dog-eat): Covers calorie and protein needs for aging dogs, when to transition to senior food, signs of under- and overfeeding, and the importance of muscle mass monitoring.

- [Puppy Weight Chart by Breed Size](https://petpawcalc.com/blog/puppy-weight-chart-by-breed-size): Weight charts by breed size category (toy through giant) from 8 weeks to adulthood. Includes adult weight estimation formula and nutrition guidance for large-breed puppies.
- [Kitten Weight Chart by Age](https://petpawcalc.com/blog/kitten-weight-chart-by-breed-size): Birth-to-12-month weight chart for kittens, the "1 pound per month" rule of thumb, and a comparison of typical domestic-shorthair growth vs. slow-maturing large breeds (Maine Coon, Ragdoll, Norwegian Forest Cat).

- [Why Is My Cat Always Hungry?](https://petpawcalc.com/blog/why-is-my-cat-always-hungry): Explains calorie needs by life stage, common reasons cats seem perpetually hungry (underfeeding, low-satiety food, medical causes), and how to assess whether intake is appropriate.

- [How to Tell If Your Dog Is Overweight](https://petpawcalc.com/blog/how-to-tell-if-dog-is-overweight): Three at-home body condition checks (rib test, waist check, profile view). Covers the Body Condition Score (BCS) scale and steps to take if a dog is overweight.

- [The True Cost of Owning a Cat vs Dog](https://petpawcalc.com/blog/true-cost-cat-vs-dog-year-by-year): Year-by-year cost comparison across the full lifetime of a dog vs cat, broken down by category. Includes time cost and commonly underestimated expenses.

- [How Often Should You Take Your Dog to the Vet?](https://petpawcalc.com/blog/how-often-vet-visits-dog-cost-by-age): Recommended vet visit frequency by life stage (puppy, adult, senior) with what each visit should cover and typical costs.
- [Flea & Tick Prevention Cost for Dogs and Cats](https://petpawcalc.com/blog/flea-tick-prevention-cost): Cost breakdown by product type (topical, chewable, combo, collar), why prices vary by dog size and brand, and a cost comparison of prevention vs. treating a flea infestation, heartworm, or tick-borne disease after the fact.

- [How Much Does a Vet Visit Cost?](https://petpawcalc.com/blog/how-much-does-a-vet-visit-cost): Detailed cost breakdown for routine exams, vaccines, bloodwork, dental cleanings, emergency visits, and specialist care. Includes geographic variation and cost management strategies.

- [How Long Are Dogs Pregnant?](https://petpawcalc.com/blog/how-long-are-dogs-pregnant): 63-day gestation overview with week-by-week development guide. Covers what to expect each week and how to prepare for whelping.

- [What to Feed a Pregnant Dog: Complete Diet & Nutrition Guide](https://petpawcalc.com/blog/what-to-feed-pregnant-dog): Trimester-by-trimester diet and nutrition guide for pregnant dogs. Covers calorie increases, food type recommendations, supplements, and what to avoid.

- [How to Tell If Your Dog Is Pregnant](https://petpawcalc.com/blog/how-to-tell-if-dog-is-pregnant): Early and later signs of dog pregnancy by week, how to distinguish from false pregnancy, and how veterinarians confirm pregnancy (palpation, ultrasound, relaxin test, X-ray).

- [Signs of Dog Labor: What to Expect Hour by Hour](https://petpawcalc.com/blog/signs-of-dog-labor): Hour-by-hour breakdown of dog labor — pre-labor signs, Stage 1 and Stage 2 labor, placenta delivery, and when to call the vet. Covers the temperature drop method and post-whelping monitoring.

- [How to Reduce Vet Costs Without Compromising Your Dog's Care](https://petpawcalc.com/blog/how-to-reduce-vet-costs-for-dogs): Practical strategies for lowering lifetime vet costs — pet insurance timing, emergency funds, preventive care ROI, dental care, low-cost vaccine clinics, and when to use urgent care vs. the ER.

- [How Often Should Cats Go to the Vet? A Schedule by Age](https://petpawcalc.com/blog/how-often-vet-visits-cat): Recommended vet visit frequency for cats by life stage (kitten, adult, senior) with what each visit should cover, indoor vs. outdoor differences, and typical costs.

- [How Long Are Cats Pregnant?](https://petpawcalc.com/blog/how-long-are-cats-pregnant): Feline gestation overview with week-by-week development guide. Covers signs of pregnancy, what to prepare, and how to support your cat through delivery.

- [How to Tell If Your Cat Is Pregnant](https://petpawcalc.com/blog/how-to-tell-if-cat-is-pregnant): Early and later signs of cat pregnancy by week, how false pregnancy differs from dogs (less common, subtler signs), and how veterinarians confirm pregnancy (palpation, ultrasound, X-ray).

- [What to Feed a Pregnant Cat: Complete Diet & Nutrition Guide](https://petpawcalc.com/blog/what-to-feed-pregnant-cat): Stage-by-stage diet and nutrition guide for pregnant cats. Covers calorie increases, why taurine matters more for cats than dogs, food type recommendations, and what to avoid (including raw fish).

- [Signs of Cat Labor: What to Expect](https://petpawcalc.com/blog/signs-of-cat-labor): Pre-labor signs, stage-by-stage breakdown of feline labor, kitten delivery, and when to contact a vet. Covers nesting behavior, contractions, and post-birth monitoring.

- [How Much Should a Cat Weigh?](https://petpawcalc.com/blog/how-much-should-a-cat-weigh): Healthy weight ranges by breed and sex, how to assess body condition score at home, and what to do if your cat is overweight or underweight.

- [How Much Does a Cat Vet Visit Cost?](https://petpawcalc.com/blog/how-much-does-a-cat-vet-visit-cost): Detailed cost breakdown for cat vet care — routine exams, vaccines, spay/neuter, bloodwork, dental cleanings, and emergency visits. Includes indoor vs. outdoor cost differences and ways to reduce costs.

- [How to Reduce Vet Costs Without Compromising Your Cat's Care](https://petpawcalc.com/blog/how-to-reduce-vet-costs-for-cats): Practical strategies for lowering lifetime cat vet costs — pet insurance timing (cats are cheaper to insure than dogs), emergency funds, why annual bloodwork matters more since cats hide illness, low-cost vaccine/spay-neuter clinics, and when to use urgent care vs. the ER.

- [How Much Should a Senior Cat Eat?](https://petpawcalc.com/blog/how-much-should-senior-cat-eat): Calorie and protein needs for aging cats by weight, why senior cats often need more protein not less, wet vs. dry food considerations, feeding frequency, and how to monitor body condition in older cats.

- [Dog Quality of Life: How to Assess Your Dog's Well-Being](https://petpawcalc.com/blog/dog-quality-of-life-assessment): Explains the HHHHHMM Scale (Hurt, Hunger, Hydration, Hygiene, Happiness, Mobility, More good days than bad), how to score each category honestly, how to track trends over time, and what scores below 35 mean in practical terms.

- [Cat Quality of Life: How to Assess Your Cat's Well-Being](https://petpawcalc.com/blog/cat-quality-of-life-assessment): Applies the same HHHHHMM Scale to cats, with cat-specific guidance on why quality-of-life assessment matters even more for cats (they mask pain and illness far better than dogs). Covers cat-specific signs for each category — reduced grooming, reluctance to jump, hiding — and how to use scores over time.

- [How to Tell If Your Cat Is Overweight](https://petpawcalc.com/blog/how-to-tell-if-cat-is-overweight): Three at-home body condition checks for cats (rib test, waist check, belly check), explains the primordial pouch and how it differs from excess fat, the 1-9 BCS scale, and a critical warning against crash dieting cats due to hepatic lipidosis risk.

- [Puppy and Kitten Vaccination Schedule: The Complete Guide](https://petpawcalc.com/blog/puppy-kitten-vaccination-schedule): Week-by-week core vaccine timeline for puppies (DHPP, rabies) and kittens (FVRCP, rabies, FeLV), explains why multiple doses are needed (maternal antibody interference), non-core vaccines by lifestyle, adult booster schedules, and typical costs.

- [Spay or Neuter Your Pet: Cost, Timing, and What to Expect](https://petpawcalc.com/blog/spay-neuter-cost-and-timing): Covers spay vs. neuter cost differences by species and dog size, private vs. low-cost clinic pricing, factors that add to cost (cryptorchidism, being in heat), best age for the procedure, recovery timeline, and where to find low-cost or free programs.

- [Dog and Cat Dental Cleaning Cost: What to Expect](https://petpawcalc.com/blog/dog-cat-dental-cleaning-cost): Explains why extractions (not the base cleaning) drive the final bill, why anesthesia is medically required rather than optional, why anesthesia-free cleanings are opposed by major veterinary bodies, typical cost breakdown, and how often cleanings are needed by breed.

- [Pet Euthanasia: What It Costs and What to Expect](https://petpawcalc.com/blog/pet-euthanasia-cost-and-what-to-expect): A compassionate, practical overview covering typical costs (clinic vs. in-home, cremation options), what the procedure involves, whether to be present, and questions worth asking a vet in advance. Written in an informational, non-clinical tone given the sensitivity of the topic — no calculator, by design.

## About

PetPawCalc is focused on a single niche: calculators and practical guides for US pet owners. All tools are free, require no account, and are designed to give immediately usable outputs. Content follows veterinary guidelines and includes disclaimers where appropriate. The site does not provide medical diagnoses or medication dosing.

Contact: canghun13@naver.com
